notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. Phase changes: 1068 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Pr; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.757$ kcal/mol. 1204 K, melting point of Pr; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.646$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{0} = 41.700 + 3.760 \times 10^{-3} T$ $H^{0}-H_{298}^{0} = 41.700 \times 10^{-3} T + 1.880 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} - 12.600$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-1068 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -435.807 + 12.504 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 6.749 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 77.300 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -435.807 - 12.504 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} + 6.749 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 38.650 \text{T}^{-1} + 180.979 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1068-1204 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -430.906 - 2.556 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 1.240 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 136.600 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -430.906 + 2.556 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} - 1.240 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 68.300 \text{T}^{-1} + 79.995 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1204-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -431.943 - 5.796 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 1.240 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 136.600 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -431.943 + 5.796 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} - 1.240 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 68.300 \text{T}^{-1} + 57.873 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Source: Data from Mills (80) who estimated all except enthalpy of formation at 298 K.
